coverage_note: Arabic-script only for 00:13-05:00; 05:00 onward is Latin transliteration by the engine. 20:00-31:00 the engine DROPPED most of Medi's Arabic (lines like 'So is it ?', 'It's , right?'), so the causative-adjective drill (bit'eb/mot'eb, biz'al, bizahhe2) and the 'flight/meetings/parents' sentences could not be audited from his words; only Amal's prompts and chat lines survive there. 47:00-49:00 and 1:01:10-1:03:10 are English chat. Pronunciation-only fixes left out per S4/F1-F3: kuffet->khuffet (09:14), sawa->sawwa vowel length (46:19), double-T in ma tetta3ebhom (53:59) and matta3bina (58:57), azra2 echo (04:31). Self-fixes left out: mu5talef->mu5talefa (03:02), kunnet->kan (19:59), alaina->alay (13:20, folded into the asabulna row). tmarranet (01:39) matches her sheet 'Ana tmarranet' so not written. Speaker labels looked right throughout.

rows.english: (I woke early) to exercise / and I exercised.

rows.why: 'I bored him' - he attached -ak (you) instead of -o (him); she prompted 'Him' and he fixed to زهرته at 05:46.
'She got bored' - he built the she-form on the I-form vowel (zehe-at); she recast zhe2et and explained the internal vowel change.

rows.why: 'Did you guys get tired' - he stacked the they-ending and the you-pl ending (tabu-tu); she recast te3ebtu.

rows.amal_said: You got the verb right, but what's the should preposition?
rows.why: 'I got worried about you' takes 3ala, not -l-; she prompted for the preposition and he fixed to 'khuffet aleiki' at 10:54.

rows.medi_said: Khawaf. So, uh, khawaf, khawafit, khawafik

rows.why: He used the causative khawwaf (I scared you) for 'I got scared of you'; she said that means 'I scared you' and he fixed to khuffet minik at 12:02.
'Why did you (f) get angry' needs the -ti ending; he offered two forms and she picked 3assabti.
'They got angry at me' takes 3ala + me; he used -lna (to us); she re-prompted and he reached 'alay' at 13:20, which she confirmed at 13:27.
'Got bored of it' takes min; he first said there is no preposition (14:42), then tried -l-o; she kept prompting 'of it' until he said 'leesh zehekti minno' at 15:20.
rows.english: Why did you get bored of it?

rows.amal_said: No. It's an adjective ... Ana khayef.

Second attempt at 'I am scared' with the verb again after the 16:15 correction; she recast 'ana khayef' and he accepted at 17:38.
'The show was funny' = kaan + causative yda77ek; his form 'yadahu' lost the causative shape/ending; she recast 'kan yadahak' and he repeated.
rows.english: The show was funny (made one laugh).

'Did you guys scare him' needs the -uh object on the verb; transcript shows bare khawaftu, her chat spells 5awwaftuh (the -h may have been swallowed in speech).

'You make ME angry' needs the -ni object on the verb; she prompted 'Me' and he fixed to 'Bit'asibini' at 37:24.
'What YOU told me' is 7akaiti-li (you-f + to me); 'haket' reads as the I-form and 'illi' as the 'to me' piece; she let it pass and typed the full form later (may be transcription).
